item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: make a talking video from this pic about our sale

dialog.agent:
I can make this, but I need a few details first so the video doesn't say something wrong about your sale:

1. **What's the sale?** For example, the store or brand, the discount ("30% off everything"), the dates, and the call to action ("Shop at example.com").
2. **Exact wording, if you have it.** If not, I'll write a short line from your details.
3. **Is this you, or someone who said yes to this?** I can only animate a real person's face with their permission.

**Length limit:** On your free plan, videos where the person speaks a script from text max out at **5 seconds**. That's about 10–12 words, like *"Huge sale this weekend: 30% off everything. Shop now!"*

**If you need it longer:**
- **Send a voice recording of the script.** I can sync his lips to it for a longer clip.
- **Use a generated voice.** I can turn your script into speech with a generic voice and sync that instead. (I won't use a celebrity voice for an ad.)

Send the sale details and I'll start.
dialog.why: It asks for the sale details, the wording, and whether the person has consented, then waits for the user to reply before starting.
dialog.user: it's just our sale, keep it general, don't make up discounts or dates. you write the line, keep it upbeat

turns.agent:

This is what I tried to make:
- **Line:** *"Our big sale is on now! Come check it out today!"* It's upbeat, with no discounts or dates.
- **Settings:** a 5-second clip at 480p (the free-plan limit).

I went ahead on the understanding that you have permission to use this person's face.

**To finish it, you have two options:**
1. **Add credits** to your Magic Hour account, by buying a credit pack or waiting for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run the same video again.
2. **Record the line yourself** as a short audio clip and send it. I can make his lips move to your recording instead. That kind of video also costs credits, so it still needs some in your account.

Do you want me to change the line before you top up?
